summary: Frontend-only testing of CHANGE 1 (Fee Collection class → student dropdown) and CHANGE 2 (Students page classFilter persistence via sessionStorage). Both changes verified working end-to-end. Two minor testability gaps found and fixed by tester (added missing data-testid attributes on back button and student rows).
critical_code_review_comments: FeeCollection.jsx (~650 lines) is at the upper bound of the 700-line threshold; consider splitting the student-picker card, monthly/full/custom tabs, and summary card into sub-components in a follow-up refactor.

In FeeCollection.jsx, when a class is selected but the picked student has no fee schedule, nothing renders below the picker (sched is null). The spec mentions an 'no assignment empty state' — consider showing an explicit empty-state message so the user knows the pick succeeded (currently silent).
Placeholder count for LKG showed 12 (real data) vs spec's expected 13 — not a bug, just an out-of-date spec/seed drift.

Students.jsx: sectionFilter is NOT persisted via sessionStorage — only classFilter is. If the user set section too, it will still be lost on nav-back. Consider persisting sectionFilter and search for parity.
Testability: back button on StudentDetail and rows on Students had no data-testid — tester added `back-to-students` and `student-row-{id}` as required by spec. Please retain these when refactoring.
test_credentials: admin@stanvard.school / Admin@2026 (KNP school admin) — verified working
seed_data_creation: None — used existing real seed (KNP branch, 375 students).
context_for_next_testing_agent: CHANGE 1 (Fee Collection): verified — popover shows on All Classes, class Select swaps to plain dropdown [data-testid=fee-collect-class-student-select] listing students of chosen class with name · admission# · Section, switching class resets previously selected student to placeholder, All Classes brings popover back. CHANGE 2 (Students): verified — classFilter is written to sessionStorage['students_class_filter'] on change and initialized from it on mount; navigating to student detail and clicking back preserves the filter; hard reload of /students also restores last filter. Regression: search + filter combo, All Classes returns full 375. NOTE for main agent: sectionFilter/search are NOT persisted (only classFilter), which is per spec but may cause slight surprise if user relies on section filter.
